text: One possible independent candidate has been identified: LibreCAD stable 2.2.1.5 (GPLv2), with documented generic DXF read/write and R12 support. It is not an apparel CAD or standards certificate. No files or installer were downloaded. Proposed next test is one C:-confined all-seven R12 round trip with fixed settings and the existing 0.001 cm gate; await maintainer authorization before software installation/execution. CLO stays open and untouched.
